manifest.name: APP-µ
manifest.description: Application lifecycle and binding-chain auditor. Defines app specs (kuhul.app-spec.v1), scaffolds the full 6-point binding chain for any new micronaut, loads micronauts into the bus registry, and audits completeness (micronaut JSON + track JSON + shell PSM1 + commands action + registry node + name_map entry). Proposal-only — scaffold outputs are proposals until XCFE admits them.

xcfe.note: app.scaffold emits typed proposals — it does not write files. app.audit is data_only. app.load requires explicit xcfe_admitted status before modifying BusRegistry.

app.spec.description: Pop/Wo-phase: validates or defines a kuhul.micronaut.atomic.v1 or kuhul.app-spec.v1 structure. Accepts id, name, role, phases, atomic_keys, authority, drivers; emits a typed spec proposal for review before scaffold is invoked.

app.scaffold.description: Yax/Sek-phase: generates scaffold content for the full 6-point binding chain of a micronaut — micronaut JSON template, track JSON folds template, shell PSM1 file, commands.ps1 case block, registry node JSON, name_map entry. Proposal only — produces artifact text, does not write files. XCFE must admit before any artifact is committed.

app.load.description: Pop-phase: resolves micronaut bridge JSON at data/micronauts/{name}.micronaut.json, calls Register-Micronaut, adds entry to BusRegistry. Requires micronaut JSON present and xcfe_admitted.

app.audit.description: Yax-phase read-only audit: checks the 6 binding-chain points for a named micronaut (or all registered micronauts when target=all). Reads micronaut JSON to resolve track_ref rather than guessing the filename. Returns per-micronaut checklist with present/missing status and a coverage score.

audit_points.note: resolved from micronaut JSON track_ref field

app.health.description: Pop-phase: reports BusRegistry size, registered micronaut IDs, audit coverage summary (complete vs partial vs missing), and APP-WIZARD-µ link availability.

driver_roles.Micronaut.Core.dll: lifecycle, registry load, scaffold template generation
driver_roles.CFPC.Patterns.dll: spec validation and gap detection for incomplete binding chains

cache.note: Audit results cached 10s — rerun with force=true to bypass

relations.note: APP-WIZARD-µ handles runtime recipe synthesis; APP-µ handles binding lifecycle
Gemma provides KeyAlign and AppSpec ops used in scaffold generation
